tools.name: search_titles
tools.description: Find films, TV series, books and video games in the Boxlist catalogue by name (books also by author). Returns each title's boxlist.com page and a `ref` to pass to the other Boxlist tools. Use it to pin down the right title (e.g. which "Dune") before asking for a taste profile or similar titles.
